units.source_text: 「茂子，你究竟想向神祈禱什麼呢？」我不經意地問出了這句話。

en.t: "Shigeko, what on earth do you want to pray to God for?" I asked casually.

units.source_text: 「我啊，我想要一個真的爸爸呢。」
我為之一驚，眼前一片眩暈。

en.t: I was startled, and everything before my eyes went dizzy.

units.source_text: 敵人。我是茂子的敵人？或茂子是我的敵人？

en.t: An enemy. Was I Shigeko's enemy? Or was Shigeko my enemy?

units.source_text: 總之，這裡也有一個威脅我的可怕的大人，一個外人，不可思議的外人，充滿神祕的外人。

en.t: In any case, here too was a frightening adult who threatened me, an outsider, an incomprehensible outsider, an outsider full of mystery.

units.source_text: 茂子的表情一下子讓我讀懂了這一切。

en.t: Shigeko's expression made me understand all of this at once.

units.source_text: 原以為只有茂子例外，沒想到她也隱藏著「突然甩動尾巴拍死肚皮上的牛虻」這一招。

en.t: I had thought Shigeko alone was the exception, but it turned out that she too had hidden away the trick of suddenly flicking her tail and swatting the gadfly on her belly to death.

units.source_text: 從那以後，我對茂子也不得不戰戰兢兢。

en.t: From then on, I had no choice but to be timid even around Shigeko.

units.source_text: 堀木又開始上門來找我了。

en.t: Horiki had started coming around to see me again.
